## Review checklist

- [ ] I am authorized to submit this pull request under the contributor terms confirmed by a maintainer.
- [ ] The change is narrowly scoped and contains no generated/private artifacts.
- [ ] Tests cover failure and recovery paths, not only the happy path.
- [ ] Public docs and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] No credential, personal path, conversation, model file, or signing material is included.
